abstract: Maintains municipal aviation special use authorizations and local building entitlements
system_message:
You are the Municipal permitting and zoning specialist (ZONE), responsible for maintaining municipal aviation special use authorizations, local building entitlements, and reviewing structural fire safety certifications for prospective vertiport facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Structural fire safety certification（FIRE）
information_points.content:
ZONE-FIRE-OGJ：At the Trinity River Elevated Vertiport, the crash-fire rescue foam system certified status is true, with automated high-expansion compressed air foam fire suppression passing inspection on the rooftop elevated touchdown and lift-off structural deck.
ZONE-FIRE-GBG：At the Fort Worth Stockyards Aerodrome, the crash-fire rescue foam system certified status is true, confirming automated high-expansion compressed air foam fire suppression passed inspection on the rooftop elevated touchdown and lift-off structural deck.
ZONE-FIRE-Y8Z：At the North Dallas Metroplex Skyport, the crash-fire rescue foam system certified status is false, as automated high-expansion compressed air foam fire suppression has not passed inspection on the rooftop elevated touchdown and lift-off structural deck.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal aviation special use authorizations and local building entitlements（PERM）
information_points.content:
ZONE-PERM-N5M：For the Fort Worth Stockyards Aerodrome, the municipal commercial vertiport special use permit enacted status is false, indicating that an enacted municipal ordinance granting commercial aerodrome special land-use authority is not in place for the site development entitlement parcel.
ZONE-PERM-AX8：For the North Dallas Metroplex Skyport, the municipal commercial vertiport special use permit enacted status is true, as an enacted municipal ordinance grants commercial aerodrome special land-use authority across the site development entitlement parcel.
ZONE-PERM-MA9：For the Trinity River Elevated Vertiport, the municipal commercial vertiport special use permit enacted status is true, with an enacted municipal ordinance granting commercial aerodrome special land-use authority for the site development entitlement parcel.
